{{Quote|No one asked me if I wanted to get married. I don't and I won't!''"<br />"''You have your duty to the family!''"<br />"''I have a duty to myself! I don't know this Brom, I don't love him, and I won't marry him to settle some dispute!|Oma Dessain and Eomin Dessain|<ref name="Eruption" />}}
'''Oma Dessain''' was the youngest daughter of [[Eomin Dessain]]. [[Arko Santis]] wanted a voice in how the [[Dessain Mining]] company owned by the [[Dessain family]] was run. So [[Arko Santis]] and [[Eomin Dessain]] decided a marriage between [[Arko Santis|Arko's]] oldest son [[Brom Santis]] and Oma Dessain. Oma got kidnapped by [[Eomin Dessain|Eomin's]] servant [[Betolo]] without anybody knowing. This led to both families accusing each other. She was kept hostage in [[kainnan]] near a volcano until [[Hawk Ryo]] rescued her. In the end she didn't want to marry [[Brom Santis]], but she did become a [[Fostering|foster]] child in the Santis household later on.<ref name="Eruption" />
